== a backend that compiles to the internal format ==

This is the source text of a a backend for the language machine metalanguage compiler. This backend compiles the internal representation produced by the forntend to an internal format that can be directly loaded by the language machine. 

The language machine is (C) Copyright 2005 Peri Hankey and is published under the Gnu General Program License. It comes with absolutely no warranty.

== wrap frontend analysis with backend contexst ==
  .lmn2x(B)
  - var Is = 0; var If = 0; units  <- outer ;

== rules that generate output ==
  .lmn2x(1010R)
    eof                            <- generate eof;
    - lmn                          <- generate ;
    - uri                          <- lmn    - ;
    say output                     <- lmn    - ;
    - out                          <- output - ;

== some objects that are internal to this backend ==
    w                              <- lmn - 'w'             sp ;
    g                              <- lmn - 'g'             sp ;
    gx                             <- lmn - 'G'             sp ;
    vx                             <- lmn - 'V'             sp ;
    sx :X                          <- lmn - '(' sp   X  ')' sp gx;

    zzz  lineNo :A <- lmn - say "ERROR (feature not implemented) near line " A "\n" output ;

== the interface between the frontend and backend ==
    eoc                            <- lmn - ;
    eox                            <- lmn - '.' sp ; 
    lu :X                          <- lmn - X ; 

    top  :X                             <- lmn - lm :X 'T' nl;
    rdef      :A :G :P :N :I :L :J :R   <- lmn - m :G P  n:N lm :{ I L } lm :{ J R } 'r' nl    ; 
    rval rdef :A :G :P :N :I :L :J :R   <- lmn -    G P nm:N sx :{ I L } sx :{ J R } op:'rule' ;
    
== flattening is not needed in this backend ==
    fd :F :A                       <- lmn - ;
    sd :I :B                       <- lmn - ;
    ad :I :B                       <- lmn - ;
    
== injected and nested sequences ==
    ij :I :X                       <- lmn - sx:X op:'inj' ; 
    lm :X                          <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp ;

    bx :X                          <- lmn - X ;
 
== symbols and similar primitive objects ==
    void                           <- lmn - 'z'       sp ; 
    c  :X                          <- lmn - 'c:' X    sp ; 
    d  :X                          <- lmn - 'm:' X    sp ; 
    m  :X                          <- lmn - 'm:' X    sp ; 
    n  :X                          <- lmn - 'n:' X    sp ;  
    v  :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X    sp ; 
    x  :X                          <- lmn - 'l:['X']' sp ;  

== priority speficifiers (only in rule headers) == 
    lp :X                          <- lmn - 'L:' X    sp ;  
    rp :X                          <- lmn - 'R:' X    sp ;  
    bp :X                          <- lmn - 'B:' X    sp ; 
    mp :X                          <- lmn - 'M:' X    sp ; 


== various kinds of operand ==
    ac :I :X                       <- lmn -        X  ; 
    sv :I :X                       <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp gx; 
    sq :I :X                       <- lmn - '(' sp X ')' sp gx; 
    dq :X                          <- lmn - 'd:' X       sp gx; 
    ty :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;  
    vr :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;
    va :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp vx;  
    sy :X                          <- lmn - 'v:' X       sp gx;  
    nm :X                          <- lmn - 'n:' X       sp gx; 
    
== various special operations ==
    ax :X                          <- lmn - X         'B' sp ; 
    al :X                          <- lmn - X         'A' sp ; 
    ex :X                          <- lmn - X         'E' sp ; 
    ea :X                          <- lmn - X         'e' sp ; 
    t                              <- lmn -           't' sp ; 
    pp :X                          <- lmn - X         'p' sp ; 
    pq :I :B                       <- lmn - lm  :B    'p' sp ;  
    pb :X                          <- lmn - X         'b' sp ; 
    ap :X                          <- lmn - X     op:'apply' ; 
    op :X                          <- lmn - 'f:' X        sp ;   
    ou :X                          <- lmn - X op:"append" sp ; 
    truth :V                       <- lmn - op :V ;

== repeat and option constructs ==
    r1     :I :B                   <- lmn -   m:"option"  B  ;
    rz     :I :B                   <- lmn -   m:"repeat"  B  ;
    rn :X  :I :B                   <- lmn - X m:"repeatN" B  ;

== array subscripts and fields ==
    idx  :A :B                     <- lmn - A    B       op:'idx' ;
    dot  :A :B                     <- lmn - A    d :B gx op:'idt' ;

== array literals ==
    arrayinit  :A                  <- lmn - args :A op:'array' ; 
    cellN      :X                  <- lmn - X ; 
    cellV      :N  :X              <- lmn - N X op:'cell' ; 

== initialisation of variables ==
    inits    :A                    <- lmn - A  eox ; 
    initz    :A                    <- lmn - sy :A sy:"null" w ; 
    initv    :A :B                 <- lmn - sy :A B         w ; 

== conditionals ==
    xif      :E :A :B              <- lmn - E sx:A B op:'if' ; 
    xelsif   :E :B :C              <- lmn - sx :{ iff :B :C :A }; 
    xelse    :B                    <- lmn - sx :B  ; 
    xelsez                         <- lmn - sx :{} ;

== loop constructs ==
    xnext    :E                    <- lmn - E ;
    xtest    :E                    <- lmn - E op:test ;
    xdo      :E :B                 <- lmn - sx :{ B  E }    op:'loop';  
    xwhile   :E :B                 <- lmn - sx :{ E  B }    op:'loop'; 
    xfor     :I :E :N :B           <- lmn - I sx :{ E B N } op:'loop'; 
    
    xcont0                         <- lmn - op :"continue";     
    xbreak0                        <- lmn - op :"break" ;

== function calls are mapped to the extension interface ==
    arg   :A                       <- lmn - A ; 
    fn    :F :A                    <- lmn - F  op:'args' A op:'fun' ; 
    args  :A                       <- lmn - op:'args' A ; 

== expressions transmitted in categorised prefix form ==
    br    :A                       <- lmn - A ; 
    ","   :A :B                    <- lmn - A eox B ;
    "?"   :A :B :C                 <- lmn - A sx :{ B } sx:{ C } op:'sel' ; 
    fl :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A sx :{ B } op:F  ;  
    fA :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fa :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fb :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fc :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fe :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ;  
    fq :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fx :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    fs :F :A :B                    <- lmn - A B op :F ; 
    
    ur   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    ux   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    ub   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ; 
    aa   :unary :F :A              <- lmn - A   op :F ;  
    
    "-"                            <- unary :"neg" ;
    "~"                            <- unary :"inv" ;
    "!"                            <- unary :"not" ;
    
    pre  :preop  :F :A             <- lmn - A  F;  
    post :postop :F :A             <- lmn - A  F; 

    "--"                          <- postop  :{ op:'postdec' }; 
    "++"                          <- postop  :{ op:'postinc' }; 

    "--"                          <- preop   :{ op:'predec' }; 
    "++"                          <- preop   :{ op:'preinc' };
